description: This file defines the Properties class used for reading document properties from Gnumeric spreadsheet files within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods to parse different XML structures and set metadata properties such as title, author, description, keywords, etc.

classes.name: Properties
classes.description: Provides methods to read and interpret document properties from Gnumeric XML data, updating the associated Spreadsheet object's properties accordingly.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the Properties object with a Spreadsheet instance.

methods.name: readProperties
methods.description: Main method that processes the XML to extract document properties from either old or current Gnumeric formats.
